title: [Audit] 🌍 Geo & Network
description: Real client geography from forwarded_ip, geo-resolved at ingest. Impossible-travel detection.

config.content:
### Where your users and API keys connect from

See activity by country and city, your busiest client addresses, and anyone seen in more than one country, a sign of a shared or stolen credential. Raw records: [All audit events](/app/discover#/view/cloud-audit-search-all-events), [Raw signal feed](/app/discover#/view/cloud-audit-search-raw-signal-feed).

Locations come from each client's real address, not Elastic's own network hops. Country is reliable; city is often your internet provider's nearest hub. Private network addresses cannot be placed on a map.

**How to use it:** choose a Project, Identity type, Identity or Client IP in the controls and set the time picker. Click an address or email in a table to add a filter pill, which every page in the suite keeps.

- Every address is the real client, forwarded by Elastic Cloud’s proxy; the proxy’s own address is never used for location.
- Only placed events appear on maps; “Geo resolution of audited events” accounts for the rest.
- Platform-internal (100.64/10) is Kibana calling Elasticsearch for a user, not a failed lookup; private and no-IP events cannot be placed.
- Location lookup applies only to events after it was switched on, so an address’s older events count in All events, not Placed events.
- Impossible travel lists people only; machines are multi-region by design.
- Identities read as in the Identity dropdown, a Cloud API key shortened to “_4KEO… · Cloud API key”. The dropdowns apply to this page only; the links above do not carry them.

config.description: Events whose client location could be resolved: the Resolved row of “Geo resolution of audited events”.

data_source.query: SET unmapped_fields="nullify"; FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-default | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart AND ((?project == "" OR ?project == "Any") OR project.name == ?project) AND ((?identity == "" OR ?identity == "Any") OR user.email == ?identity OR api_key.name == ?identity OR user.name == ?identity OR user.name == REPLACE(REPLACE(?identity, " · Cloud API key$", ""), "^Unnamed key of ", "") OR (?identity == "(unattributed)" AND user.name IS NULL)) AND ((?identity_kind == "" OR ?identity_kind == "Any") OR (?identity_kind == "Person" AND user.email IS NOT NULL) OR (?identity_kind == "Elasticsearch API key" AND user.email IS NULL AND api_key.name IS NOT NULL) OR (?identity_kind == "Elasticsearch API key (name not recorded)" AND user.email IS NULL AND api_key.name IS NULL AND user.domain == "_es_api_key") OR (?identity_kind == "Cloud API key" AND user.email IS NULL AND api_key.name IS NULL AND user.domain == "_cloud_api_key") OR (?identity_kind == "Service account" AND user.email IS NULL AND api_key.name IS NULL AND user.domain == "_service_account") OR (?identity_kind == "Failed sign-in" AND user.email IS NULL AND api_key.name IS NULL AND (user.domain IS NULL OR NOT user.domain IN ("_cloud_api_key","_es_api_key","_service_account")) AND event.action IN ("authentication_failed","anonymous_access_denied")) OR (?identity_kind == "Unattributed" AND user.email IS NULL AND api_key.name IS NULL AND (user.domain IS NULL OR NOT user.domain IN ("_cloud_api_key","_es_api_key","_service_account")) AND (event.action IS NULL OR NOT event.action IN ("authentication_failed","anonymous_access_denied")) AND user.name IS NULL) OR (?identity_kind == "Other" AND user.email IS NULL AND api_key.name IS NULL AND (user.domain IS NULL OR NOT user.domain IN ("_cloud_api_key","_es_api_key","_service_account")) AND (event.action IS NULL OR NOT event.action IN ("authentication_failed","anonymous_access_denied")) AND user.name IS NOT NULL)) AND ((?identity == "" OR ?identity == "Any") OR user.email == ?identity OR (user.email IS NULL AND api_key.name == ?identity) OR (user.email IS NULL AND api_key.name IS NULL AND user.domain == "_cloud_api_key" AND ENDS_WITH(?identity, " · Cloud API key") AND user.name == REPLACE(?identity, " · Cloud API key$", "")) OR (user.email IS NULL AND api_key.name IS NULL AND user.domain == "_es_api_key" AND STARTS_WITH(?identity, "Unnamed key of ") AND user.name == REPLACE(?identity, "^Unnamed key of ", "")) OR (user.email IS NULL AND api_key.name IS NULL AND (user.domain IS NULL OR NOT user.domain IN ("_cloud_api_key","_es_api_key")) AND user.name == ?identity) OR (?identity == "(unattributed)" AND user.email IS NULL AND api_key.name IS NULL AND (user.domain IS NULL OR NOT user.domain IN ("_cloud_api_key","_es_api_key")) AND user.name IS NULL)) AND ((?client_ip == "" OR ?client_ip == "Any") OR client.ip == TO_IP(CASE((?client_ip == "" OR ?client_ip == "Any"), null, ?client_ip))) | WHERE client.geo.country_iso_code IS NOT NULL | STATS `Geo-resolved events` = COUNT(*)

config.description: Share of events placed in a country: the honest denominator for every geographic panel here. It can be low, because events with no forwarded IP, Elastic’s internal hops and private addresses cannot be placed.

config.description: Events by real client country, shaded teal (few) to pink (most) on a log scale. Hover a country for details. The title line says how much traffic could be placed: a blank country is not proof of no traffic.
